+def get_isbn_10_and_13(isbns: str | list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Separate IA ISBNs by length after removing spaces and hyphens."""
+    isbn_10, isbn_13 = [], []
+    if isinstance(isbns, str):
+        isbns = [isbns]
+
+    for isbn in isbns or []:
+        if not isinstance(isbn, str):
+            continue
+        value = re.sub(r'[\s-]+', '', isbn).upper()
+        if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{9}[0-9X]', value):
+            isbn_10.append(value)
+        elif re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{13}', value):
+            isbn_13.append(value)
+
+    return isbn_10, isbn_13
+
+
+def get_publisher_and_place(
+    publishers: str | list[str],
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Separate IA's ``Place: Publisher`` entries into publisher and place lists."""
+    publisher_names, publish_places = [], []
+    if isinstance(publishers, str):
+        publishers = [publishers]
+
+    for publisher in publishers or []:
+        if not isinstance(publisher, str) or not publisher.strip():
+            continue
+        place, separator, name = publisher.partition(':')
+        if separator:
+            place, name = place.strip(), name.strip()
+            if place and name:
+                publisher_names.append(name)
+                publish_places.append(place)
+        else:
+            publisher_names.append(place.strip())
+
+    return publisher_names, publish_places
